name: Rose Card
source:
Rose is a nun of the Church of Alicism from the town of Custom. Despite her status, she isn't a devote follower of the church's doctrine at all and actually uses the Church's donations for her own benefit. She loves leisure, gold and fornication and is actually willing to sell herself just for the fun of the experience. She's carefree and lazy most of the time. While she doesn't care about the church and mostly works as a nun for personal benefit, she's not a bad woman. She's willing to aid and assist anyone who needs it. She is also competent in Divine Magic and doesn't have any problem with using it for free to anyone injured asking for her help.

Her favourite hobby is to fornicate with Devils, something that is completely against the Church of Alicism since sex with Devils is a forbidden pleasure, and they are the epitome of the anti-gods as well. Rosé doesn't care the slightest about it, and secretly spends her time with Devils she made pacts with or work under her. She claims that sex with humans is boring and lousy when compared to Devils, and doesn't have interesting in copulating with humans anymore, unless it's in exchange of money.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Ros%C3%A9_Card]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
